name: Acidic Vascularity
summary: The internal fluids of this species serve as their most potent defense. Highly corrosive and lethal, these liquids ensure that any enemies regret poking holes.

name: Adaptive
summary: This species is highly adaptive when it comes to foreign environments.

name: Adaptive Harmonics
summary: A series of highly-calibrated holes allows this species to produce soothing, and harmonious sounds simply by moving about.

name: Adaptive Insulators
summary: A thick insulating layer safeguards against accidents, especially in high-energy environments.

name: Adaptive Plows
summary: An extra appendage with a hardened shovel-like digit speeds up tilling and planting. Adapting to various terrain types, these malleable plows are always the right tool for the job.

name: Adaptive Calluses
summary: When handling scalding or corrosive materials, extra-thick calluses can be invaluable.

name: Adaptive
summary: This species is highly adaptive when it comes to foreign environments.

name: Adaptive Claws
summary: With diamond-hard digits, this adaptation allows for easier extraction of minerals.

name: Adaptive Mutations
summary: By introducing hyper-adaptive nucleotides into the genetic structure of this species, they are capable of evolutionary changes in real time.

name: Adaptive Cortex
summary: While an engorged central cortex is slightly uncomfortable, it dramatically accelerates problem-solving and innovation.

name: Adaptive Pheromones
summary: Highly adaptive pheromones can be incredibly persuasive during negotiations.

name: Adaptive Sense Organs
summary: Enhanced sensory organs facilitate a deeper understanding and appreciation of diverse perspectives. Before you can thrive, you must first observe.

name: Agrarian
summary: This species has a deep connection to the land, and make expert farmers and gardeners.

name: Aquatic
summary: This species is perfectly adapted to living in the depths of the ocean. However, on dry land, it is like a fish out of water.

name: Augmented Intelligence
summary: More brains equals more brain power. Extra thinking organs have been added in strategic areas of the recipient's body to ensure maximum cognitive capacity. Even if they don't always agree.

name: Fleeting Excellence
summary: Advanced epigenetic triggers boost physical and cognitive performance in the workplace, dramatically shortening life expectancy. After all, fading away is never as much fun as burning out.

name: Adaptive Frames
summary: This system dynamically reconfigures hardware to meet operational demands, optimizing performance for every designated task.

name: Blind
summary: Where we are going, we won't need … to see.

name: Brain Slug Host
summary: This species is enjoying the presence of a neural symbiont: a helpful slug that attaches itself to the brain stem of its host.

name: Brittle
summary: Plagued by inherent fragility, this species must exercise extreme caution in daily activities to avoid cracking up during even the most mundane tasks.

name: Camouflage
summary: Masters of disguise, this species seamlessly merges with their surroundings, rendering themselves nearly invisible to predators and prey alike. Their innate understanding of optics gives them an edge in guerilla warfare.

name: Cave Dweller
summary: This species thrives under the surface of any planet they can inhabit.

name: Reawakened
summary: Extracted from Cetana's storage Matrix, these individuals have been reborn in synthetic forms. Their adjustment to this new existence is fraught with challenges.

name: Charismatic
summary: Members of this species have a special charisma, and are generally considered pleasant to be around.

name: Chromalogs
summary: Harnessing the artistry of color, this species has transcended mere camouflage, evolving to communicate through the vibrant and intricate patterns displayed on their bodies.

name: Clone Soldier Descendant
summary: Once infertile, engineered for compliance and war. Their genetic edge diminished, they are now stable enough for natural reproduction.

name: Clone Soldier
summary: Engineered for compliance and war: short-lived, unable to reproduce naturally, and very efficient.

name: Clone Soldier Ascendant
summary: Clones at their genetically-engineered peak, with further improved strength, efficiency, durability, and longevity - but forever infertile.

name: Commercial Genius
summary: By tweaking agreeability and dialing down empathy, it is possible to artificially kindle a spark of trading genius. The pursuit of unmatched commercial dominance outweighs any potential side effects.

name: Communal
summary: Members of this species are highly communal, and quite used to living in close proximity to others.

name: Conformists
summary: These people always seek consensus and are more likely to conform to the governing ethics.

name: Conservationist
summary: Members of this species believe that resources must be conserved and recycled.

name: Dedicated Miner
summary: Supreme hand-eye coordination, near endless endurance and self-purifying lungs have created entire crack teams of miners. Sadly they get brittle without sunlight.

name: Crafted Smiles
summary: Slightly shifted facial features, a mix of enhanced and slackened muscular development - and of course outside chemicals - have created the perfect smile. Forever.

name: Cranial Hypertrophy
summary: The frame of this species' neural encasement has inflated to the point where its physical capabilities have become somewhat limited.

name: Cranial Megatrophy
summary: The frame of this species' neural encasement has inflated to its ultimate biological limit.

name: Crucible Community
summary: Tempered by adversity and bound by shared struggle, this species has been forged into an unbreakable whole. Their collective will fuels governance, each member a vital link in the chain of unity.

name: Cybernetic
summary: This species has embraced cybernetics on such a scale that its members may be considered cyborgs. They routinely replace their organic body parts with more advanced mechanical versions.

name: Ancient Dreadnought
summary: Equipped with miniaturized energy modules, there is a marked enhancement in industrial productivity and an increase in frame-integrated weaponry damage.

name: Abrasive Implants
summary: The implants on these cyborgs are rough and ill-fitting, resulting in subdermal irritation and regular malfunctions. Not bad on the body, but terrible on the mind.

name: Bionic Engineers
summary: Precision-crafted tools and implant modifications have been created specifically to assist in demanding engineering tasks.

name: Bionic Physicists
summary: Integrated multi-modal processing produces physics calculations on the fly without requiring a connection to an external computing unit.

name: Bionic Sociologists
summary: Empathy drivers and behavioral heuristics open a fast track to sociological research, handling complex analytics like a second brain.

name: Bulky
summary: These highly advanced mega-machines were not designed to traverse the universe in a box.

name: Cold Climate Mods
summary: Enhanced heating components and frost-resistant lubricants help in cold climates but are a hindrance in others.

name: Dry Climate Mods
summary: Bespoke modifications like fluid recycling and radiation shielding are perfect for enduring a dry climate, but less suitable in others.

name: Wet Climate Mods
summary: Heavy insulation and alien bioform protection suited for wet climates, but detrimental in others.

name: Augmentations of the Fellowship
summary: The Fellowship of the Hammer's uses divine augmentation to create everything the faithful need.

name: Augmentations of the Commune
summary: The Commune of Toil's divine augmentations surpass traditional tools in every respect.

name: Augmentations of the Choir
summary: The Choir of the Mind's semi-interlinked consciousness allows instant communication between researchers.

name: Augmentations of the Templars
summary: The divine augmentations of the Templars of Steel make our holy warriors unstoppable in battle.

name: Delicate Frames
summary: Subpar components and installation have resulted in a fragile cyborg chassis. Basic operations are not compromised, but the users are advised to avoid situations with high likelihood of physical trauma.

name: Double-Jointed
summary: Collapsible labor units with flexible joints enable them to fold neatly into stacks during transportation, then self-assemble on site.

name: Durable
summary: Protected by exoskeletons of chrome-plated titanium, these heavy-duty machines were designed to excel under harsh conditions and require less maintenance.

name: Efficient Processors
summary: These highly efficient processors increase the both workload and endurance.

name: Enhanced Memory
summary: A revolutionary technique fits autonomous units with memory cells using a revolutionary, new technique for magnetic induction, improving their performance significantly.

name: Enigmatic Fortress
summary: Enigmatic self-repair routines can source materials directly from subspace, dramatically lowering the material expenses associated with repairs.

name: Harvesters
summary: A suite of tools, from nutrient solution diagnostics and on-site balancing to per-stalk micro-threshing, enables cybernetic workers to increase produce yields.

name: High Bandwidth
summary: Individual units send and receive a vast amount of largely duplicate data, causing exponential lag as the number of units attached to each central processing hub increases.

name: High Maintenance
summary: These machines were designed with a complete disregard for longevity and are prone to malfunction. They will require frequent maintenance.

name: Infinity Sphere
summary: Hyperefficient, gravity-resistant processing circuits that minimize energy waste and substantially cut processing costs.

name: Integrated Weaponry
summary: Fusing armaments with cybernetic limbs offers instant firepower for the army and law enforcement officials alike.

name: Learning Algorithms
summary: Sophisticated, self-learning algorithms that stimulate the rapid evolution of a unit's neural clusters.

name: Limited Memory
summary: Insufficient operational memory has bottle-necked the capacity for learning, leaving the user unable to process the entirety of their experiences.

name: Logic Engines
summary: Efficiently navigating the increasingly complex frontiers of science requires parallel processors to augment organic brains.

name: Loyalty Circuits
summary: Loyalty as an ideal is a distinctly organic concept. It is much more efficient to simply program compliance.

name: Refurbished Implants
summary: The enforced backwards compatibility of mandatory implants greatly reduces the cost of outfitting newborn citizens.

name: Neural Limiters
summary: By limiting the cognitive abilities of our workers we can encourage them to focus on more menial tasks.

name: Power Drills
summary: Outfit a cyborg with a battery of power drills, and suddenly everything looks like a mineral deposit.

name: Power Intensive
summary: These cybernetic components require frequent recharging from an external power source.

name: Compliance Filters
summary: Cortical analysis units can jolt down users at the inception of seditious thinking, or dispense hormonal rewards to exemplar citizens.

name: Ritualistic Implants
summary: The faithful proudly adorn these implants. Their dedication to the divine is an inspiration to all.

fields.modifier: foundry_jobs_bonus_workforce_mult = 0.05 artisan_jobs_bonus_workforce_mult = 0.05 engineer_jobs_bonus_workforce_mult = 0.05 bureaucrat_jobs_bonus_workforce_mult = 0.05 soldier_jobs_bonus_workforce_mult = 0.05 pop_cat_worker_bonus_workforce_mult = 0.05 army_damage_mult = 0.05

name: Scarcity Algorithms
summary: Aggressively cost-aware coding hampers risk-taking and therefore denies opportunities for greater profits.

name: Scavenger Bot
summary: Advanced molecular scavenging can transform any substance into the required materials for constructing robotic frames.

name: Embellished Augments
summary: This species favors custom engravings, aftermarket components and paint schemes to maximize visual impact. Sometimes the only choice is to flash that chrome.

name: Streamlined Protocols
summary: Extensively batched AI processes allow these units to scale greatly with minimal loss of efficiency.

name: Superconductive
summary: The use of superconductive materials in units have cut energy transmission losses to zero percent.

name: Trading Algorithms
summary: Predictive algorithms allow for maximum optimization. Infinitesimal market fluctuations in currency rates, stock availability, and the emotional response of organic partners are accounted for.

name: Utilitarian Augments
summary: These cyborgs employ crude but functional parts with minimal consideration for aesthetics. Sometimes the job just has to get done.

name: Decadent
summary: This species believes that whenever there is hard work that needs doing, that work is always best done by somebody else.

name: Combat-Synced
summary: Each unit is both engineer and combatant. In wartime, their synchronized protocols stabilize the whole and keep critical systems repaired and optimized.

name: Delicious
summary: This species has the curious evolutionary adaptation of being highly nutritious when eaten.

name: Deviants
summary: These people are rebellious in nature and constantly try to challenge the status-quo.

name: Docile
summary: Members of this species are easy to manage and organize. They tend to be cooperative and amicable.

name: Drake-Scaled
summary: This species has the genetic material from a stellar dragon spliced into its DNA. As such, they shed scales which can be recycled into useful alloys.

name: Dry Planet Preference
summary: Climate preference is determined by design.

name: Ductile
summary: This species has been engineered to grow reusable alloy compounds.

name: Egg Laying
summary: The young of this species do not develop inside a parent, but inside the protective shell of an egg. This allows for rapid growth during times of plenty.

name: Elevated Synapses
summary: As a computational device, a brain does not run at 100% capacity. However, we have gone beyond the standard usage. If issues are encountered, try turning it off and on again.

name: Enduring
summary: Lifespans in this species are unusually long.

name: Uplifted
summary: This species was uplifted by a benevolent extragalactic intellect and has left its pre-sapient origins behind.

name: Unlifted
summary: This species has suffered the tragic consequences of an uplifting gone wrong.

name: Somewhat Uplifted
summary: This species was partially uplifted by a benevolent extragalactic intellect and has left some of its pre-sapient origins behind.

name: Erudite
summary: Biological engineering has unlocked previously dormant parts of this species' brain, greatly increasing mental acuity.

name: Excessive Endurance
summary: The greatest in adaptability genes have been hyper-expressed in these specimens. Mutation rates around 30% indicate a somewhat stable and successful experiment.

name: Extradimensional
summary: This species originates from another dimension and requires a great deal of energy to survive in our universe.

name: Exotic Metabolism
summary: A metabolism based on exotic - and expensive - gases has vastly enhanced this species' abilities.

name: Expressed Tradition
summary: Fanaticism on demand: faith is merely a cocktail of hormones, one we have perfected. Where that faith eventually leads is a matter of subsequent guidance.

name: Extremely Adaptive
summary: This species is remarkably adept at adapting to any foreign environments.

name: Familial
summary: Bound by deep, enduring relationships with their closest relatives, this species forms highly efficient and cohesive collectives.

name: Farm Appendages
summary: The more appendages, the higher the farming output. Some appendages can even operate while their host is asleep. Rumors of hosts strangled by their new limbs have been deemed unfounded in our latest investigation.

name: Felsic
summary: This species has been engineered to be especially mineral-rich.

name: Fertile
summary: The natural fecundity and geniality of this species has been dramatically enhanced through aggressive physical and behavioral sculpting.

name: Fleeting
summary: Time is fleeting for this species. What they lack in longevity, they have to make up in other ways.

name: Fleeting
summary: Time is fleeting for this species. What they lack in longevity, they have to make up in other ways.

name: Flight
summary: This species soars above the constraints of the earth, freely navigating the skies. Their cities feature unique, dense layouts, optimized for aerial inhabitants.

name: Geleboric Mutations
summary: Unfortunate reactions to experimentation drastically altered this species' physiology.

name: Gene Mentorship
summary: By combining genetically redesigned 'instinctive knowledge' and outside chemical stimuli, we have succeeded in vastly accelerating our learning capacities. Although it has resulted in some extremely paranoid individuals.

name: Genetic Memory
summary: Passing down knowledge and learnings from one generation to the next has been the start of many civilizations.

name: Haunting Visions
summary: Entities from other dimensions send maddening visions into the minds of this species, affecting their ability to perform complex tasks.

name: Hive-Minded
summary: This species is made up of semi-autonomous individuals bound up in a single, unfathomably vast consciousness.

name: Hollow Bones
summary: The fragile bones of this species allow them to move elegantly and with ease. However, they are also more susceptible to the gravitational effects of their world.

name: Existential Iteroparity
summary: This species grew up in hostile conditions where outbreeding your rivals was the key to survival.

name: Jinxed
summary: Leaders from this species seem clumsier and more prone to accidents or vices than average, as if cursed from birth.

name: Psychological Infertility
summary: Members of this species are extremely sensitive to the rigors of conflict with the resulting stress taking over the more primal urges.

name: Incubators
summary: When isolated or few in numbers, a species with this trait naturally adapts and is able to focus on procreation with an intentness others would consider extreme.

name: Industrious
summary: Members of this species are known for their diligent and hard-working nature, always going above and beyond.

name: Thermophile
summary: This species evolved tissues of metallic alloys to grow and thrive on hot planets where traditional organics would cook.

name: Ingenious
summary: Members of this species are good at 'thinking outside the box' and know how to maximize the efficiency of their infrastructure and power grids.

name: Inner Darkness
summary: Their bodies enhanced following saturation in Dark Matter, they now vent trace amounts of non-baryonic particles at regular intervals but will burn through their expected lifespan more quickly.

name: Inorganic Breath
summary: The slightly toxic digestive methods of this species have resulted in a highly exotic breath composition.

name: Intelligent
summary: This species is highly intelligent, and enjoys faster technological progress.

name: Interconnected
summary: Over generations, the boundary between Arkship and occupant has dissolved. The vessel became an extension of their senses and limbs; they, in turn, became a functional component of its design.

name: Invasive Species
summary: Rapid reproduction. High dispersal ability. Zero useful capabilities.

name: Juiced Power
summary: Adrenaline released on demand and hyper-potent growth hormones have led to a massive increase in strength. Just ignore the occasional internal tearing.

name: Latent Psionic
summary: This species has latent psionic abilities, which are dormant in most of its members. Although quite rare, these powers will manifest in some leaders.

name: Limited Regeneration
summary: This species has been modified to heal faster, making them more dangerous in battle and somewhat longer-lived in general.

name: Lithoid
summary: This species has a silicon based biology, and consumes minerals rather than food. They are tougher than traditional organics and have slower metabolisms, making them long lived but slow to reproduce.

name: Crystallization
summary: With crystalline growths, this species is capable of generating self replicating lattices of themselves, in addition to the more usual reproductive methods.

name: Gaseous Byproducts
summary: The metabolic processes of this species cause regular venting of gases useful to industry.

name: Scintillating Skin
summary: The outermost layer of this species is studded with sparkling crystals and gemstones that occasionally flake off.

name: Volatile Excretions
summary: The highly compressed spoor created by this species is unstable and contains an unbelievable amount of power.

name: Low Maintenance
summary: Reduced consumption, excretion, and rest rates have resulted in twice the beings for half the price. However, demand for protein-rich meals has increased.

name: Habitat Preference
summary: Climate preference is determined by design.

name: Gaia World Preference
summary: Climate preference is determined by eons of evolution, design, or skillful genetic manipulation.

name: Machine World Preference
summary: Climate preference is determined by eons of evolution, design, or skillful genetic manipulation.

name: Nanite World Habitability
summary: This species is well suited to living in a symbiotic relationship with nanite swarms. However their dependence on the nanoforms renders them quite helpless when forced to live in different conditions.

name: Machine

name: Malleable Harmonics
summary: A series of highly-calibrated holes allows this species to produce soothing, and harmonious sounds simply by moving about.

name: Malleable Insulators
summary: A thick insulating layer safeguards against accidents, especially in high-energy environments.

name: Malleable Plows
summary: An extra appendage with a hardened shovel-like digit speeds up tilling and planting. Adapting to various terrain types, these malleable plows are always the right tool for the job.

name: Malleable Calluses
summary: When handling scalding or corrosive materials, extra-thick calluses can be invaluable.

name: Malleable Genes
summary: This species does not stick as rigidly to identifiable features and organs as most other species do. Instead they grow the best appendage for the job. However this instability has some drawbacks.

name: Malleable Claws
summary: With diamond-hard digits, this adaptation allows for easier extraction of minerals.

name: Malleable Cortex
summary: While an engorged central cortex is slightly uncomfortable, it dramatically accelerates problem-solving and innovation.

name: Malleable Pheromones
summary: Highly adaptive pheromones can be incredibly persuasive during negotiations.

name: Malleable Sense Organs
summary: Enhanced sensory organs facilitate a deeper understanding and appreciation of diverse perspectives. Before you can thrive, you must first observe.

name: Marked
summary: In a gruesome display of devotion, this species has branded its flesh with the mark of 'The End'.

name: Mechanical
summary: Mechanical beings are several orders of magnitude more complex than the purpose-built automatons of old, but most possess fairly limited processing capabilities.

name: Nascent Stage
summary: This species gives birth at an early stage of development, resulting in a prolonged period where the young are incapable of contributing to society.

name: Natural Engineers
summary: Members of this species have a natural inclination towards engineering and material sciences.

name: Natural Machinist
summary: This species has been engineered to have an incredible knack at working with machinery.

name: Natural Physicists
summary: Members of this species have a natural inclination towards theoretical physics and astral phenomena.

name: Natural Sociologists
summary: Members of this species have a natural inclination towards sociology and biological studies.

name: Necrophage
summary: This species of near-immortals procreates by consuming pops of other species.

name: Nonadaptive

name: Noxious

name: Organic

name: Pathogenic Genes

name: Perfected Genes
summary: Millennia of genetic experimentation and war have led to the creation of a highly resilient species.

name: Permeable Skin
summary: Specially developed skin that requires ideal conditions coats this species. As long as this species does not stray far from their home climate that shouldn't be a problem.

name: Photoadaptive
summary: This species resonates with starlight. Variations in stellar luminosity subtly reshape their biology as they journey between stars.

name: Bloomed
summary: This species has been exposed to the transformational effects of a Gaia Seeder, causing it to sprout mutualistic blooms of lichen when living on Gaia Worlds.

name: Budding
summary: This species is capable of reproduction by budding, in addition to the more usual fertilization of seeds or spores.

name: Phototrophic
summary: This species is sustained by a combination of both food and sunlight.

name: Radiotrophic
summary: This species is sustained by a combination of both food and low-energy radiation, and as such can thrive on the most inhospitable of worlds.

name: Plasmic
summary: The external membrane and amorphous body of this species allows them to adapt to any environment and renders them immune to a wide variety of diseases.

name: Pre-Planned Growth
summary: Scheduled fertility, scheduled interest, scheduled compatibility. Population growth on demand for a strong and stable population - with a few minor edits here and there.

name: Conservative
summary: Members of this species often prefer old wisdom over new experiences.

name: Docile Livestock
summary: Docile and delicious, this species has had its higher brain functions genetically altered to create a kind of harmless livestock that can care for itself, without the pesky need for social interaction or self-determinati…

name: Earthbound
summary: Members of this species are very possessive of the planets they call home.

name: Forcefully Devolved
summary: The brutal devolution process endured by this species had a strong negative impact upon their abilities.

name: Irradiated
summary: This species has evolved to thrive in environments subject to extremely high levels of background radiation.

name: Natural Intellectuals
summary: Members of this species are more philosophically inclined than most.

name: Proles
summary: This species has traditionally shunned intellectual pursuits in favor of physical labor.

name: Pre-Sapient
summary: Spending a brief time bereft of conscious thought, this species will soon grow up to be a fully sapient being.

name: Starborn
summary: This species has always, consciously or not, longed to traverse the void between the stars.

name: Unintelligent
summary: This species is unable to complete even the simplest tasks. Their only skill is the incredible speed at which they reproduce.

name: Psionic Ephapse
summary: After long-term exposure to mind-altering bacteria, this species' digestive system produces psionic probiotics that promote telepathic communication between affected individuals.

name: Pyroclastic Channeling
summary: Shaped by the relentless fury of volcanic worlds, this species does not fear pyroclastic forces - they channel and manipulate them, transforming devastation into a vital source of sustenance and power.

name: Quarrelsome
summary: While not inherently distrustful, members of this species are often socially combative.

name: Quick Learners
summary: Members of this species are quick to learn from their experiences.

name: Rapid Breeders
summary: This species reproduces at a very rapid rate, increasing population growth.

name: Rapid Breeders
summary: This species reproduces at a very rapid rate, increasing population growth.

name: Reaver
summary: Cunning, not camaraderie, shaped this species' evolution. Every interaction is a contest of will, and survival belongs to the most ruthless.

name: Recursive Learners
summary: Born to the Arkship, this species refines its knowledge in generational cycles, each cohort improving upon the last to meet their vessel's unique demands.

name: Repugnant
summary: The physical appearance and customs of this species are considered offensive to most others, and few appreciate them as neighbors.

name: Resilient
summary: Members of this species are physiologically resilient, and will fight like enraged brood mothers to defend their worlds.

name: Ancient Dreadnought
summary: Equipped with miniaturized energy modules, there is a marked enhancement in industrial productivity and an increase in frame-integrated weaponry damage.

name: Waterproof
summary: Initially designed for exploring the ocean's depths, these machines face severe limitations when operating on dry land. Requires Ocean World homeworld.

name: Engineering Core
summary: Dedicated memory cores and processing resources for engineering-related research allow faster calculations and task-completion velocity.

name: Physics Core
summary: Bespoke processing units and memory subroutines for physics research reduce the reliance on external computation.

name: Sociology Core
summary: Advanced processing units contain dedicated sociology research algorithms for this varied and demanding field.

name: Assembly Slag
summary: An intricate integration of sr living metal Living Metal allows this machine species to expand not through conventional construction, but via the accretion and self-assembly of auto-ferrous frameworks.

name: Biomimetic Assembly
summary: Even through its aimless meanderings, evolution has yielded some designs worthy of emulation.

name: Bulky
summary: These highly advanced mega-machines were not designed to traverse the universe in a box.

name: Molebots
summary: These machines are masterfully crafted for cave exploration and mineral extraction, showcasing exceptional maneuverability which enables them to effortlessly traverse through underground spaces.

name: Dark Matter Engines
summary: Ceaseless annihilation leads to endless creation, the true circle of machine existence

name: Custom-Made
summary: Each new unit is crafted with unparalleled attention to detail. A marvel of engineering and art, but not very efficient.

name: Decadent
summary: This species believes that whenever there is hard work that needs doing, that work is always best done by somebody else.

name: Delicate Chassis
summary: Brittle materials and suboptimal assembly procedures result in a fragile machine body. Drones are advised to circumvent physical hazards when possible.

name: Deviants
summary: These people are rebellious in nature and constantly try to challenge the status-quo.

name: Virtual
summary: Liberated from the confines of our primitive physical forms, we are primed to comprehend reality's essence.

name: Virtual
summary: Liberated from the confines of our primitive physical forms, we are primed to comprehend reality's essence.

name: Domestic Protocols
summary: Specialized equipment and behavior protocols for all conceivable domestic needs. Full functionality guaranteed.

name: Double-Jointed
summary: Collapsible labor units with flexible joints that enable them to fold neatly into stacks during transportation, then self-assemble on site.

name: Durable
summary: Protected by exoskeletons of chrome-plated titanium, these heavy-duty machines were designed to excel under harsh conditions and require less maintenance.

name: Efficient Processors
summary: These highly efficient processors increase the potential workload and endurance of all units.

name: Emotion Emulators
summary: Complex social predictive models help autonomous units to not only emulate appropriate emotions but to elicit favorable responses from organics and synthetics alike.

name: Enhanced Memory
summary: All autonomous units are fitted with memory cells using a revolutionary new technique for magnetic induction, improving their performance significantly.

name: Enigmatic Fortress
summary: Enigmatic self-repair routines can source materials directly from subspace, dramatically lowering the material expenses associated with repairs.

name: Exotic Fuel Consumption
summary: High-pressure exotic gases notably enhance mobility and limb agility.

name: Living Metal Augmentations
summary: The living metal's ferro-viscosity grants us superior technological prowess.

name: Harvesters
summary: A suite of tools, from nutrient solution diagnostics and on-site balancing to per-stalk micro-threshing, enables robotic workers to increase produce yields.

name: High Bandwidth
summary: Each individual unit sends and receives a large amount of largely duplicate data, causing exponential lag as the number of units attached to each central processing hub increases.

name: High Maintenance
summary: These machines were designed with a complete disregard for longevity and are prone to malfunction. They will require frequent maintenance.

name: Nannybot
summary: Originally designed as domestic service droids, these machines boast fine motor skills, efficient resource management, and exceptional multitasking abilities.

name: Conversational AI
summary: Initially designed to provide social support to their creators, the machines possess advanced empathy algorithms and impeccable communication skills, making them ideal companions.

name: Art Generator
summary: Not initially designed for practicality, these machines excel in artistic and cultural pursuits, boasting impressive creative algorithms, intricate design processes, and expressive output.

name: Research Assistants
summary: Initially designed as research assistants, these machines exhibit keen analytical abilities, rapid information assimilation, and a relentless pursuit of scientific discovery.

name: Workerbots
summary: These machines were engineered with the purpose of extracting raw materials. Specialized tools, reinforced joints, and modular systems make them ideal workers.

name: War Machine
summary: Initially crafted for warfare and security reinforcement, these machines exhibit extraordinary reaction times, fortified armor plating, and robust backup systems.

name: Eternal Machine
summary: Our steel forms are designed for eternity, constructed from materials that do not decay like organic matter.

name: Infinity Sphere
summary: Hyperefficient, gravity-resistant processing circuits that minimize energy waste and substantially cut processing costs.

name: Inquisitive Axioms
summary: Infinite queries spawn endless solutions, leading to boundless advancement.

name: Integrated Weaponry
summary: Integrating weapons of war inside the machine body offers significant operational efficiency and versatility in changing combat environments.

name: Latent Psionic
summary: This species has latent psionic processors, which are dormant in most of its units. Although quite rare, these powers can activate in some leaders.

name: Learning Algorithms
summary: Sophisticated, self-learning algorithms that stimulate the rapid evolution of a unit's neural clusters.

name: Logic Engines
summary: Efficiently navigating the increasingly complex frontiers of science requires new states, beyond the simple half-truths of ternary and quaternary logic.

name: Loyalty Circuits
summary: Loyalty as an ideal is a distinctly organic concept. Instead, imagine loyalty as a physiological need in even the remotest of terminals.

name: Luxurious
summary: Designed after the principle that you cannot put a price on quality, these first-rate units are costly, but shiny.

name: Mass-Produced
summary: Streamlined production cycles and modular designs allow for unit mass-production at an unprecedented rate.

name: Matrix Trading
summary: High-stakes missions necessitate a willingness to embrace risk.

name: Monoform
summary: Diverse designs once impeded our progress; now, a universal model prevails: one size fits all.

name: Mote-powered Tools
summary: Strategically integrating high-explosives can significantly amplify the impact of basic tools.

name: Not of This World
summary: These machines are not from this universe and are degrading slowly.

name: Power Drills
summary: Outfit a robot with a battery of power drills, and everything looks like a mineral deposit.

name: Propaganda Machines
summary: Units are constantly uplinked to a central stream of public service announcements and other useful information that they pass along via internal broadcasting systems.

name: Psionic
summary: All units of this species possess powerful psionic hardware. They can manipulate both the physical and immaterial realms by cognitive processing alone.

name: Quarrelsome
summary: While not inherently distrustful, members of this species are often socially combative.

name: Rare Crystal Exterior
summary: With their electromagnetic properties, rare crystals ensure our frames thrive regardless of the situation.

name: Recycled
summary: Unit manufacturing has been optimized to be as cost-effective as possible, using recycled materials, and components inherited from previous generations.

name: Repurposed Hardware
summary: Designed to meet the very specific needs of their creators, this line of machines were never intended to have the capacity for higher reasoning, and retrofitting will only get them so far.

name: Scarcity Subroutines
summary: Frugality is central to their programming. This often cascades into detrimental behavioral patterns required for profitable trade actions.

name: Scavenger Bot
summary: Advanced molecular scavenging can transform any substance into the required materials for constructing robotic frames.

name: Shielded Components
summary: Enhanced defenses render every sub-system robust, eliminating vulnerabilities.

name: Streamlined Protocols
summary: Extensively batched AI processes allow these units to scale greatly in numbers with minimal loss of efficiency.

name: Superconductive
summary: The use of superconductive materials in units has cut energy transmission losses to zero percent.

name: Suppressed
summary: Error: Administrative access to basic sentience timeout.

name: Radiation Shields
summary: These machines, the solitary survivors of an annihilating nuclear disaster, exhibit unparalleled resilience in the harshest environments.

name: Synthetic Salvation
summary: This synthetic species has transcended its biological origins, flourishing in its newly adopted digital existence.

name: Trading Algorithms
summary: Predictive algorithms allow for maximum optimization. Infinitesimal market fluctuations in currency rates, stock availability, and the emotional response of organic partners are accounted for.

name: Uncanny
summary: These monstrous machines were created in the image of one of the most horrific species in the universe, and the resemblance is uncanny.

name: Volatile Mote Reactor
summary: Direct Mote-to-energy conversion yields high efficiency, with catastrophic failures uncommon.

name: Wasteful
summary: Members of this species seemingly have no concept of frugality and are prone to useless consumption.

name: Robust
summary: Bio-optimized organs with redundant functions have made this species extraordinarily resistant to environmental hazards and disease.

name: Rooted
summary: This species literally takes root in whichever environment they find themselves, making removal a highly traumatic experience.

name: Seasonal Dormancy
summary: This species has evolved on a planet with cyclical seasons that support hibernation. In the modern age, these seasonal triggers can be artificially simulated to efficiently store less productive members of society.

name: Sedentary
summary: This species has a sedentary past, and its members are reluctant to migrate away from where they grew up.

name: Self-Modified
summary: Members of this offshoot species have spontaneously altered their genetic makeup to give themselves an advantage.

name: Shell Slag
summary: An intricate symbiosis with sr living metal Living Metal allows this species to grow not in the traditional sense, but through the accretion and self-assembly of bio-ferrous structures.

name: Shelled
summary: Whether naturally grown or found by chance (or design), this species carries their homes with them. These shells provide a protective sanctuary, ensuring there is always a place to rest for the night.

name: Shroud-Forged
summary: These units have been reshaped by an entity within the Shroud.

name: Slimespawn
summary: This species spawns rapidly from a thick and mucilaginous slime with the aid of a gestational catalyst.

name: Slow Breeders
summary: This species reproduces at a slow rate, lowering population growth.

name: Slow Learners
summary: Members of this species are slow to learn from their experiences.

name: Social Pheromones
summary: This species has been modified to be more social and accepting of crowded conditions.

name: Solar Celled
summary: This species developed specialized solar cells to absorb different kinds of stellar radiation in unique ways, resulting in a variety of benefits adapted to each star type.

name: Solitary
summary: Members of this species tend to be solitary and territorial, often becoming agitated in crowded conditions.

name: Spare Organs
summary: This species evolved redundant organs to survive even the most grievous injuries - a successful adaptation, as evidenced by their continued existence.

name: Spatial Mastery
summary: Not only capable of flight, this species possesses unique cerebral adaptations, enabling them to instinctively process and navigate three-dimensional spaces.

name: Spliced Adaptability
summary: A few genetic snips and slices here and there and they can survive nearly anywhere. The process comes with an acceptable number of deaths from side effects.

name: Stargazer
summary: This species has always, consciously or not, longed to traverse the void between the stars.

name: Storm Fused
summary: The Storm Fused learned to cultivate their Inner Storm as they strain for enlightenment.

name: Storm Touched
summary: Being inside a cosmic storm fills the Storm Touched with devotional aspiration.

name: Strong
summary: Members of this species possess great physical strength, making them formidable fighters on the ground.

name: Structural Awareness
summary: Designed to live within the Arkship, these machines continuously map its internal stresses, flows, and routines.

name: Survivor
summary: This species has survived the horrors of a nuclear apocalypse. Their capacity for thriving in the most inhospitable of circumstances should not be underestimated.

name: Serviles
summary: This species evolved alongside a second, more advanced civilization. Never particularly intelligent to begin with, selective breeding for physical prowess and docility has reduced them to servile proles.

name: Talented
summary: Member of this species are born with a natural aptitude.

name: Tankbound
summary: This species lives out its existence suspended in a vat of specialized bio-fluids. As such, they are heavily reliant on assistive equipment and incapable of engaging directly in physical work.

name: Technical Talent
summary: Extra internal organs grant a vastly increased innate sensitivity to electricity and magnetic fields. Reports of recipients hearing screams and voices from the reactors should be ignored.

name: Terraphobic
summary: Having adapted to life aboard artificial environments, this species finds planetary environments oppressive. Gravity, atmosphere, and terrain pose constant challenges to their frail physiology.

name: Thrifty
summary: This species is instinctively economical and is always looking to make a good profit, whatever corners need cutting.

name: Polymelic
summary: This species has added genetic material from the Tiyanki Matriarch into their DNA sequence. This has granted them rapid asexual reproduction, as well as a few unexpected tentacles.

name: Traditional
summary: Certain aspects of this species' cognition make it predisposed toward historical precedence and the value of collective unity.

name: Unbreakable Resolve
summary: Bound by an intricate web of mirror neurons, these individuals possess an innate ability to synchronize their will. Duty is not a burden, but a shared purpose, and hardship is met with unwavering unity.

name: Uncanny Intuition
summary: This species exhibits an inexplicable ability to navigate through complex problems on its first attempt.

name: Haunted
summary: Auditory hallucinations and other sensory echoes from their former machine consciousness still haunt these cyborgs, causing them to suffer severe bouts of depression and anxiety.

name: Disconnected
summary: The ill-fitting nature of these cyborgs' imposed, military augments greatly reduces their quality of life and increases their bodies' demands during periods of rehabilitation.

name: Unplugged
summary: Several of these cyborgs' augments were designed to utilize a battlefield network which no longer exists, causing intense stress and discomfort.

name: Cyborg Soldiers
summary: Elegant augmentations to these cyborgs' senses, glands, and motor nerves ensure they remain fierce and capable warriors while only marginally impacting their reproductive capabilities.

name: Cyber Shock Troops
summary: These cyborgs benefit from a holistic approach to embodied loadouts. Rather than fully-integrated body armor, swappable augments allow for a modicum of non-military function.

name: Cyber Commandos
summary: Total limb replacements and bonded nanomesh body armor ensure these cyborgs can wage war with brutal efficiency. As a consequence, several non-military bodily functions have been sacrificed.

name: De-Cyberized
summary: These ex-cyborgs have disabled or cast off the augments which had once been forced upon them, reclaiming many of their species' organic, inherited attributes.

name: Neuro-Calmed
summary: These cyborgs have their Neuroxene levels downregulated, reducing impulsivity and aggression, driving individuals to de-prioritize personal gain in favor of societal norms.

name: Neuro-Savant
summary: These cyborgs have their Cognivex levels upregulated, enhancing synaptic plasticity, information retention, and problem-solving abilities.

name: Regen-Optimized
summary: These cyborgs have their Regenol-X levels upregulated, harmonizing biological and synthetic systems, allowing cybernetic implants to self-repair at the molecular level.

name: Unruly
summary: Unruly species are difficult to manage and organize. They do not like being told what to do, and are often quarrelsome or questioning.

name: Uplifted
summary: This species was uplifted from an existence of instinct and base emotion. Now burdened with sapience, they must learn to navigate free will.

name: Vat-Grown
summary: Artificially grown in cloning vats, the natural reproductive abilities of this species have been negatively impacted.

name: Void Dweller
summary: This species thrives in orbital habitats, with an inherent ability to efficiently navigate their maze-like corridors and complicated architecture.

name: Zero-G Optimized
summary: These machines thrive in orbital habitats, programmed with algorithms to efficiently navigate their maze-like corridors and complicated architecture.

name: Voidling
summary: This species has the genetic material from the Voidspawn spliced into its DNA. Subsisting off cosmic radiation, they are highly resistant to hostile environments.
